# package topic

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-sparkplugb/topic"
```

Package topic parses and builds Sparkplug B topic names in the spBv1.0 namespace: message types (NBIRTH, DDATA, NCMD, ...), edge node and device topics, and the STATE topic of a host application.
